title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 15
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'roof fall' in coal mines can be caused by
options: Weak roof strata, joints, and geological disturbances
questions.solution: Roof falls are caused by weak strata, joints, disturbances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'tamping' in blasting involves
options: Stemming the drill hole with inert material after charging
questions.solution: Stemming the drill hole with inert material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fuel storage' safety must address
options: Spill containment, fire protection, access control
questions.solution: Fuel storage needs containment, fire protection, access control.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The permissible earth leakage setting for circuits in coal mines is
options: As prescribed by regulations, typically 30 mA for portable equipment
questions.solution: Typically 30 mA for portable equipment as per regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'electric detonator' is fired by
options: Electric current from a blasting machine
questions.solution: Electric current from a blasting machine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The permissible limit of methane concentration in return air is
questions.solution: The permissible limit is 2%.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'contour map' in mining shows
options: Lines of equal elevation showing terrain shape
questions.solution: Contour maps show lines of equal elevation for terrain.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue operation safety measures' include
options: Buddy system, continuous monitoring, escape routes
questions.solution: Safety measures include buddy system, monitoring, escape routes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'dragline' in opencast mining is used for
options: Loading the coal from the face
Removing overburden from above mineral deposit
questions.solution: Draglines are large machines for overburden removal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine used for winding coal must be separate from that used for winding persons unless
options: The mine is working at low capacity
Both are equipped with all safety devices for persons
questions.solution: Separate unless both have all safety devices for persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A continuous miner machine cuts coal using
options: Rotating cutting drums with tungsten carbide bits
questions.solution: Rotating cutting drums with tungsten carbide bits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'point anchor' roof bolt is anchored by
options: Mechanical anchor point at the end of the bolt
questions.solution: Point anchor bolts are anchored by mechanical anchor at bolt end.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing efficiency' is measured by
options: Volume filled per unit time and filling factor
questions.solution: Efficiency is measured by volume/time and filling factor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosion door' in coal mines is used to
questions.solution: Explosion doors arrest explosion propagation in mine workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Regulation 153 of CMR 2017, every mine must have a
options: Proper system of ventilation as approved
questions.solution: Regulation 153 (Standard of ventilation) of CMR 2017 requires a proper system of ventilation in every mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An excavator in open cast mining is used for
options: Digging and loading overburden or coal
questions.solution: Digs and loads overburden or coal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A belt conveyor in underground mines must have
options: Fire-resistant belt and automatic fire detection system
questions.solution: Fire-resistant belt and automatic fire detection system.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The gravimetric sampling for coal dust is done using
options: A pre-weighed filter in a sampling head
questions.solution: A pre-weighed filter in a sampling head is used.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A residual current device (RCD) is used to
options: Protect against electric shock by detecting earth leakage current
Measure the temperature rise in cables
Determine the mechanical strength of materials
questions.solution: Protects against electric shock by detecting earth leakage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'powder factor' in blasting is the ratio of
options: Quantity of explosive to volume of rock fragmented
questions.solution: Quantity of explosive to volume of rock.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'subsidence control' through stowing depends on
options: Stowing ratio, material properties, and goaf conditions
The depth of the mine office
questions.solution: Subsidence control depends on ratio, material, and goaf conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'theodolite' in mine surveying is used to measure
questions.solution: Theodolites measure horizontal and vertical angles.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A shearer is used in longwall mining to
options: Cut coal from the face mechanically
questions.solution: Cuts coal from the face mechanically.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas detector' in a mine must be carried by
questions.solution: Every person entering underground areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue certification' is issued by
questions.solution: Rescue certifications are issued by DGMS.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bye-laws' for mines are made by
options: The Central Government in consultation with the State Government
questions.solution: The Central Government in consultation with the State Government.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'emergency evacuation plan' must consider
options: All work areas, haul roads, assembly points
questions.solution: Evacuation plans must cover all areas and routes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support' in a drift depends on
options: Rock quality, depth, and ground conditions
The colour of the drift mouth
The number of fans in the mine
questions.solution: Rock quality, depth, and ground conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inundation risk assessment' considers
options: The brand of the drilling machines
Geology, proximity to water, old workings, and pumping capacity
questions.solution: Risk assessment considers geology, water proximity, old workings, pumping.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'gas detection report' must record
options: The personal views of the surveyor
Type of gas, concentration, location, and time of reading
questions.solution: Type of gas, concentration, location, and time of reading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar is responsible for ensuring that shot firers
options: Are left to decide the blasting scheme
questions.solution: Shot firers must be properly instructed and supervised.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue base' in mine emergencies is established
options: At a safe location near the mine entrance
questions.solution: Rescue base is established at a safe location near entrance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The pump in a mine must be tested
options: When water is seen at the face
Regularly to ensure it is in working condition
questions.solution: Regularly to ensure it is in working condition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'leakage of air' in a mine ventilation system is detected by
options: Comparing air quantities at various points in the system
questions.solution: Comparing air quantities at various points.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine operator must hold
questions.solution: A valid certificate of competency is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In return airways and old workings, the air shall normally contain oxygen not less than ______ and carbon dioxide not more than ______.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 165: not less than 19% oxygen and not more than 0.5% carbon dioxide.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'canopy' in hydraulic supports for longwall is used to
options: Support the roof above the working face
questions.solution: Canopies support the roof above the longwall working face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, an Inspector may, among other powers:
options: Enter, inspect and examine a mine, and make inquiries on any matter relating to safety
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.22: Inspectors may enter, inspect, examine and inquire into any mine and its records.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: If the percentage of inflammable gas in the general body of air exceeds ______, persons shall be withdrawn from the working.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 166: persons are withdrawn when the general body of air exceeds 1.25% inflammable gas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'roof convergence' in underground mines is measured by
questions.solution: Roof convergence is measured using stations and extensometers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air decking' technique in blasting involves
options: Leaving air gaps in explosive column
Using compressed air to load explosives
questions.solution: Air decking leaves controlled air gaps in the explosive column to improve fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum width of a refuge hole must be
questions.solution: Regulation 94(12) of CMR 2017 requires manholes for refuge to be not less than 1.8 m in height and 1.2 m in depth, and not less than 0.75 m wide.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'spontaneous heating' indicators include
options: Rising temperature, unusual odor, smoke from goaf
questions.solution: Indicators include temperature rise, odor, smoke from goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'post-rescue medical check' for team members is important because
options: To detect exposure to toxic gases or heat stress
questions.solution: To detect exposure to toxic gases or heat stress.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'charge weight per delay' is limited to
options: Control ground vibration and air blast
questions.solution: Charge per delay is limited to control vibration and air blast.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When there is a power failure, the winding engine must be
options: Secured and persons rescued through alternative means
questions.solution: Secured and persons rescued through alternative means.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bearing plate' on a roof bolt serves to
options: Distribute load over a wider roof area
questions.solution: Bearing plates distribute load over a wider roof area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire escape routes' in mines must be
options: Clearly marked, maintained, and practiced regularly
questions.solution: Escape routes must be marked, maintained, practiced.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue operation time' considerations include
options: Air supply duration, team rotation, and escape time
questions.solution: Operations consider air supply, rotation, escape time.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'windrow' along bench edge serves as
options: A road marker for the drivers
Safety barrier to prevent vehicles going over edge
questions.solution: Windrows act as safety barriers at bench edges.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The Mines Act 1952 applies to
options: All mines including coal, metalliferous, and oil mines
Only mines with more than 100 persons
questions.solution: Applies to all mines including coal, metalliferous, and oil mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In case of a sudden water inrush, the sirdar must
options: Immediately withdraw persons and report to the manager
questions.solution: Immediately withdraw persons and report.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An electrician in a mine must hold
options: A valid competency certificate as prescribed
questions.solution: A valid competency certificate is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'near miss' is
options: An event that could have resulted in an accident but did not
questions.solution: An event that could have resulted in an accident but did not.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'development to extraction ratio' in bord and pillar must be
questions.solution: Balanced for continuous production.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The man riding car must have
questions.solution: Proper doors or safety chains are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'setting out' in mining involves
options: Transferring planned positions to ground for mining
questions.solution: Setting out transfers planned positions to ground.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per the Mines Act 1952, women may be employed aboveground only between:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.46: women shall not be employed belowground, and aboveground employment is restricted between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum working hours in a week for an adult employed belowground in a mine are:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.28: no person shall be employed belowground for more than 48 hours in any week.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main safety feature of a continuous miner is
options: Remote operation from a safe distance away from the face
questions.solution: Remote operation from a safe distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire fighting team' in a mine must be
options: Trained and equipped to handle mine fires
questions.solution: Trained and equipped to handle mine fires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'environmental impact' of stowing includes
options: Proper management of overflow water and disposal of excess material
The colour of the stowing sand
questions.solution: Management of overflow water and disposal of excess.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'roof' of a coal seam is the
options: Rock layer directly above the coal seam
questions.solution: Roof is the rock directly above the coal seam.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'escape breathing apparatus' (EBA) is different from the rescue breathing apparatus because
options: EBA is for self-rescue by miners, rescue BA is for rescue operations
EBA is heavier than rescue BA
questions.solution: EBA is for self-rescue, rescue BA is for rescue operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Regulation 196 of CMR 2017, the 'danger zone' in opencast blasting is
options: The area within 500 m of the place of firing shots
questions.solution: Regulation 196(2)(b) of CMR 2017 requires warning over the area within 500 m of the place of firing shots, defined as the danger zone.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bench marking' serves to
options: Identify bench levels and boundaries for reference
questions.solution: Bench marking identifies levels and boundaries.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'slope monitoring instrumentation' includes
questions.solution: Slope monitoring uses inclinometers, extensometers, piezometers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'temperature monitoring' in a mine is important to
questions.solution: Detects spontaneous heating early.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ram' in a hydraulic roof support is used to
options: Advance the support towards the face
questions.solution: Rams advance the support towards the working face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation report' must include
options: Air quantity, velocity, temperature, and gas readings
The duty roster of the overmen
questions.solution: Air quantity, velocity, temperature, and gas readings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When workings approach within 60 m of a water body or waterlogged area, the manager shall:
options: Stop working immediately without any plan
Leave the water body untouched forever
Mark it on the notice board
Prepare a scheme for protection against inrush and drain the water in a planned manner
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 149 (danger from surface water) & Ch. XI: within 60 m, protective schemes (drainage, barriers) are implemented.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'maingate' in longwall mining is the
options: Roadway at the intake end of the longwall face
questions.solution: Roadway at intake end of face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hydraulic transport' in stowing uses
options: Pumps and pipelines to move slurry
questions.solution: Pumps and pipelines to move slurry.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue drill' should simulate
options: Real emergency conditions including fire, inundation, or gas
questions.solution: Drills should simulate real conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'upper explosive limit' (UEL) of methane is
questions.solution: UEL of methane is 15% concentration in air.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, notice of which of the following accidents is required to be given to the prescribed authorities?
options: Loss of life, serious bodily injury, explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water or other matter
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.23: notice is required for loss of life, serious injury, and specified occurrences such as explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must have illumination of at least
questions.solution: Minimum 10 lux illumination is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Personal dust monitors must be calibrated
questions.solution: Before each use is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'face shovel' differs from a backhoe in that
options: Face shovel digs away from operator, backhoe toward
questions.solution: Face shovels dig forward; backhoes dig backward.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stemming plug' in blasting serves to
options: Confine explosive gases for better energy use
questions.solution: Stemming plugs confine gases for better energy utilization.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Some cats are dogs. All dogs are birds. Some cats are birds. This is
questions.solution: By syllogism this is definitely true.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CIL's R&D' initiatives focus on
options: Productivity improvement, safety, and environmental management
The construction of new guest houses
questions.solution: Productivity, safety, and environmental management.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Synonym of 'Meticulous' is
questions.solution: Meticulous means thorough and careful.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Methane Recovery from Coal Mines' project was supported by
options: World Bank and Ministry of Coal
questions.solution: World Bank and Ministry of Coal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If all roses are flowers, and some flowers are red, which statement is definitely true?
questions.solution: Some roses may be red — not definitely all.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India's national animal is
questions.solution: Tiger is India's national animal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal mine accident investigation' focuses on
options: Finding root cause and preventing recurrence
questions.solution: Finding root cause and preventing recurrence.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Marked 40% above CP, 20% discount. Profit %?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A clock shows 9:30. Angle between hands?
questions.solution: At 9:30, hour hand at 9.5, minute hand at 6. Angle = 3.5×30 = 105°. Wait: hour hand moves 0.5 per min. At 9:30, hour hand at 9+15=10.5 marks, minute hand at 6. Angle = (10.5-6)×30 = 135°. Hmm, let me recalc: hour hand = 9×30 + 30×0.5 = 270+15 = 285°. Minute hand = 180°. Angle = 105°.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'non-fatal accident rate' in mines depends on
options: Safety training, equipment maintenance, and supervision
questions.solution: Safety training, equipment maintenance, and supervision.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Atal Pension Yojana' provides
options: Pension benefits to unorganized sector workers
questions.solution: Pension benefits to unorganized sector.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Talcher' coalfield is located in
questions.solution: Talcher coalfield is in Odisha.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Swachh Bharat' initiative in coal mines includes
options: Sanitation, waste management, and clean mine practices
questions.solution: Sanitation, waste management, and clean practices.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'thermal power plants' in India are the largest consumers of
questions.solution: Coal is the largest consumed fuel.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.solution: Gujarat has the longest coastline.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal pillar' dimensions depend on
options: Depth of cover, seam thickness, and rock properties
The type of the winding rope
questions.solution: Depth of cover, seam thickness, and rock properties.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'highwall' in opencast mining is the
options: The unexcavated face of overburden and coal in a strip mine
questions.solution: Unexcavated face of overburden and coal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India's national bird is
questions.solution: Peacock is India's national bird.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The largest state in India by area is
questions.solution: Rajasthan is the largest state by area.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The headquarters of ICC is in
questions.solution: ICC headquarters is in Dubai.
